72 / Sage Tweed
A runway look in a pale sage tweed mini
dress with patch pockets and a
sweetheart neckline, worn over a white
shirt with a voluminous white satin bow
at the collar. White knee socks, pointed
white slingback heels and a single pale
ranunculus stem complete the look.
